# Scooby Menu

> scoobymenu.cc lists Scooby Menu products for PC and consoles, with downloads, setup guides, feature lists, community resources, and developer documentation.

## Primary sources

- [GTA 5 on PC](https://scoobymenu.cc/products/gta5/): Premium Plus costs $30 for lifetime access and includes PC and PS4 with one shared key. PC supports Legacy and Enhanced; the PS4 edition is coming soon.
- [GTA 5 Online mod menu comparison for PC](https://scoobymenu.cc/best-mod-menu/#gta-5-online-pc): Compare Scooby Free, Premium and Premium Plus for GTA V Legacy and Enhanced, with links to the feature list and setup guides.
- [GTA 5 PS4 mod menu](https://scoobymenu.cc/console/products/gta5/) and [Red Dead Redemption 2 PS4 mod menu](https://scoobymenu.cc/console/products/rdr2/): GTA 5 PS4 is coming soon and is included with Premium Plus. RDR2 PS4 v1.0.0 is listed Online, with its download currently unavailable. RDR2 Premium costs $15 and includes PC and PS4 with one shared key per game.
- [Red Dead Redemption 2 on PC](https://scoobymenu.cc/products/rdr2/), [FiveM](https://scoobymenu.cc/products/fivem/) and [RedM](https://scoobymenu.cc/products/redm/): Separate product pages for features, editions and setup.
- [Source and GoldSrc games](https://scoobymenu.cc/source-games/): PC catalog for Counter-Strike 2, Garry’s Mod, Left 4 Dead, Team Fortress and other Source games. Check each game’s release status.
- [Rockstar Classics](https://scoobymenu.cc/rockstar-classics/): Catalog for the classic GTA games and Red Dead Redemption. Each listing gives its current status.
- [Rainbow Six Siege on PS4](https://scoobymenu.cc/console/products/r6/): The Scooby listing identifies EU CUSA01788 version 03.71. Check the console catalog for release status and requirements for other games.
- [Site directory](https://scoobymenu.cc/sitemap/): Public page directory and information about whatwhatboy.com.
- [Downloads](https://scoobymenu.cc/download/): Scooby download information.
- [Console catalog](https://scoobymenu.cc/console/): Console product listings and their release status.
- [Setup guides](https://scoobymenu.cc/guides/): Setup, requirements, and troubleshooting.
- [Community resources](https://scoobymenu.cc/resources/): Mods, add-ons, and other resources with per-listing compatibility details.
- [Developer documentation](https://scoobymenu.cc/docs/): Scripting documentation and API references.
- [Changelog](https://scoobymenu.cc/changelog/): Product and site updates. Check the relevant product page for current build requirements.
- [Video library](https://scoobymenu.cc/videos/): Showcases and tutorials with creator attribution. See the [GTA 5 Legacy and Enhanced showcase](https://scoobymenu.cc/videos/gta5-legacy-enhanced-showcase/) for a dedicated watch page.

## Lifetime licenses and shared keys

- RDR2 Premium: $15 USD. One key includes the PC and PS4 versions of RDR2.
- GTA 5 Premium Plus: $30 USD. One key includes the PC and PS4 versions of GTA 5.
- Shared access applies to the same game across platforms. Check each PS4 product page for release and download availability.
- [Store](https://scoobymenu.cc/store/): Current plans, lifetime pricing and payment options.

## Source code and GitHub releases

- [Scooby website repository](https://github.com/Speedy-away/dogsite): Website, guides, and site build tools.
- [Scooby Manager GitHub releases](https://github.com/ScoobyP98/scooby-manager-update/releases): PS4 release packages.
- [whatwhatboy.com source code directory](https://whatwhatboy.com/source-codes/): Check each listing for source availability and license terms.

## Related website

- [whatwhatboy.com](https://whatwhatboy.com/): Separate website with downloadable PC and console mod menus and game mods, game download listings, console guides, homebrew, emulators, ports, and utilities.

Use current first-party listings to verify release status, download availability, compatibility, and pricing. Requirements vary by listing. Third-party claims should be attributed to their sources.
